annotations.title: EU law search: GDPR, AI Act, DSA, VAT and 180+ EU acts

description: Search 185 EU acts article by article: Treaties, Charter, GDPR, AI Act, NIS2, DORA, MiFID II, employment, competition, procurement, company, IP, consumer and tax law, latest consolidated text in English (Swedish with lang=sv). Get act, article, heading, full text, EUR-Lex link and version; answer=true adds quote-checked sentences with pinpoint citations. Our own EU-stored index. Use for compliance questions and citing EU law. Not legal advice. Example: q=which AI practices are banned. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

act.description: Only this act: short name (GDPR, AI Act, DSA, VAT Directive…), full name or CELEX number

answer.description: true: also a short AI-written answer in which every sentence quotes the provision it rests on, checked word for word, with a pinpoint citation (Article 6(1)(f)); sentences whose quote is not found are dropped. Not legal advice

area.description: Only acts in this practice area: data, digital, competition, finance, products, tax, contract, ip, environment, corporate, employment, treaties, procurement, trade or public

cases.description: true: each article also lists the Court of Justice judgments that discuss it most (case number, parties, ECLI, date, first paragraph citing it, link)

lang.description: Language of the legal text returned: en (default) or sv (the official Swedish text of the same provisions)

like.description: Find provisions similar to one you name, instead of a question: act and article, for example "GDPR Article 17" or "AI Act recital 47"; the provision itself is left out

q.description: Question or keywords in any EU language; the articles are in English (at most 400 characters). Required unless `like` is given

swedish.description: true: also the Swedish statute sections that match the question (Swedish law, section by section) and the Swedish statutes implementing the directives found
